label: Exact-content issued obligation rival
definition: ExactDuty n p means n.issued p, where Norms is a supplied extensional neighborhood of issued obligation contents. The obligation and authorization applications use separate Norms inputs; identical membership shape does not identify their normative force. issuedMail contains exactly predicates pointwise equivalent to mail. It excludes mail-or-burn because burn is a distinct outcome. No entailment closure is stipulated.
note: Analyst semantics for #1398. Interpretation and legitimate normative authority remain OPEN. See docs/notes/carneades-deontology-boundary.md, Ross section.

formal_gap.meaning: RossPermission.ExactDuty n p says that an obligation with exactly the content p has been issued: p belongs to the supplied issued-obligation contents. Its body is n.issued p. Norms n is a supplied extensional family of outcome predicates (n.issued) in TruthCore.Ethics.RossPermission (#1398); the obligation and authorization applications use separate Norms inputs.
examples: In the Ross test model, issuedMail contains exactly the predicates pointwise equivalent to mail, so mail is an exact duty.
exclusions: Mail-or-burn: a logically weaker content is not issued, because burn is a distinct outcome and no entailment closure is stipulated.
Authorization (Strong): the same membership shape does not identify their normative force.
open_obligations: The interpretation and the legitimacy of the normative authority remain OPEN.
The extensional account does not distinguish logically equivalent presentations; whether duties are hyperintensional is open.
No formalization candidate: issued content is a supplied input.
